# Abdullah Al Fahim (Fahim Rifat)

> Abdullah Al Fahim, also known as Fahim Rifat, is a creative technologist in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He works where design meets engineering: broadcast engineering at Channel i, brand identity design through his studio Utopia SoftTech, and Android and web apps such as TaskBell and Taka.

Official website: https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/

## Facts

- Name: Abdullah Al Fahim. Also known as: Fahim Rifat, Abdullah Al Faahim.
- Based in: Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- Current role: Broadcast Engineer, Transmission, at Channel i (Impress Telefilm Ltd.), since September 2024. Runs Master Control Room transmission, encoding and live contribution: 800+ live broadcasts.
- Founder and Creative Director, Utopia SoftTech (since 2018): brand identity, presentations, apps and tools.
- Previously: Executive, IT & System Support (MIS), Laptop World BD (2023–2024).
- Education: BSc in Electronics & Communication Engineering, ISTT, National University, Bangladesh (2018–2023).
- Leadership: Head of Branding & Communication, NUSDF (2023–24); General Secretary, IEEE ISTT Student Branch (2020–21); IEEEXtreme 15.0 Country Ambassador (2021).
- Skills: broadcast engineering, brand identity and graphic design, design systems, Android and web app development.

## Articles by topic

### [Broadcast engineering and TV operations](https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/blog/topic/broadcast/)

- [Designing Redundancy for 24/7 Transmission: N+1 vs 2N, Failover Testing, and When Each Is Worth the Cost](https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/blog/redundancy-n-plus-1-vs-2n-broadcast/) (2026-11-16): N+1 vs 2N redundancy for TV playout and transmission: where each fits, how to test failover properly, and when the extra cost of 2N is worth it.
- [Running an MCR Like a High-Reliability Operation: Shift Handovers, SOPs and Checklists That Prevent On-Air Errors](https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/blog/mcr-high-reliability-operation/) (2026-11-07): Run a broadcast master control room like a high-reliability operation: shift handovers, SOPs, checklists and a no-blame culture that prevent on-air errors.
- [Inside a Master Control Room: How a TV Channel Stays on Air 24/7](https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/blog/inside-a-master-control-room/) (2026-11-04): How a TV master control room keeps a channel on air 24/7: playout, monitoring, transmission and the daily habits that prevent dead air, from Channel i's MCR.
- [Moving from SDI to IP Workflows (SMPTE ST 2110): Planning, Risks and a Phased Migration Roadmap for Bangladesh](https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/blog/sdi-to-ip-st-2110/) (2026-10-04): Planning a move from SDI to SMPTE ST 2110 IP workflows: what changes, PTP timing, network design, risks for Bangladeshi TV channels and a phased roadmap.

- [Tanvir and the 50/50 Myth: What Work-Life Balance Really Means](https://abdullah-al-faahim.github.io/blog/what-work-life-balance-really-means/) (2026-11-20): Tanvir works night shifts at a TV channel in Tejgaon and has decided work-life balance is impossible for people like him. Then his grandmother, peeling oranges on a winter afternoon, gives him a better definition. A Friday story.
